entities.name: Kaalia
entities.description: A young girl with the power to break stone, named Kaa-lia by Nira before her first battle, who destroys a dragon skeleton's keystone and vows revenge on the demon.

entities.name: Nira
entities.description: A golden-furred nacatl Sunstriker who recruits Lia as a stonekiller and dies shielding her.

entities.name: The demon
entities.description: A winged demon who harvests the bones of creatures for a ritual to gain power, takes Lia's village and escapes at the end.

entities.name: Bald man
entities.description: An emaciated, toothless, unnaturally strong man who leads the ritual and throws Kaalia from the walkway before falling to his death.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: The great teacher to whom Nira's pride is loyal.

entities.name: Sunstrikers
entities.description: A band of nacatl loyal to Ajani that hunts the demon and is lost in the attack.

entities.name: Nacatl
entities.description: The cat-like people to which Nira belongs.

entities.name: Demon's servants
entities.description: Black-clad followers who kneel around the hanging bones and whose palms split open as blood rises into the sky.

entities.name: Hellkite skeleton
entities.description: A dragon skeleton hung in the arena that the demon animates in the ritual, with a keystone plate connecting the ribs.

entities.name: Keystone
entities.description: The large plate of the dragon spine connecting every rib and the wings, whose destruction causes the skeleton to fall.

entities.name: Eos Castle
entities.description: A castle on Bant that Lia imagines tumbling down.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A vast realm of floating castles, seas of grass and blue skies, where Kaalia grew up.

entities.name: The ruins
entities.description: The ruins in the mountains where the demon holds the village captive for the ritual.

events.summary: Nira, a nacatl Sunstriker, introduces herself to Lia and explains that a demon is harvesting bones for a ritual.
events.quote: He's killing countless creatures just to give himself more power,

events.summary: Nira tells Lia that the demon has taken her village and family to the ruins.
events.quote: Your family is at the ruins, too.

events.summary: Nira reveals that Lia is a stonekiller whom she needs to destroy the dragon skeleton's keystone.
events.quote: "You are," she replied. "I watched you by the river.

events.summary: Nira explains the keystone and gives Lia the warrior name Kaa-lia.
events.quote: You are now the warrior, Kaa-lia.

events.summary: Kaalia and Nira watch from a ridge as black-clad servants gather in the arena.
events.quote: a line of black-clad people shuffled silently into the arena.

events.summary: Nira and Kaalia sneak into the arena and begin climbing a rib as the ritual shakes the ground.
The servants' palms split open and blood rains upward as the ritual advances.
events.quote: Droplets of blood began to cascade upward into the sky.

events.summary: The bald man reaches the walkway and fights Nira, nearly knocking her off.
events.quote: For a leathery scrap of a man, he was unnaturally strong.

events.summary: Kaalia, imagining herself by the river on Bant, destroys the keystone.
events.quote: When Kaalia opened her eyes, the keystone was gone and a gaping hole nearly bisected the spine.

events.summary: The bald man grabs Kaalia and throws her off the walkway, and Nira leaps after her.
events.quote: And he threw her off the side.

events.summary: Nira cushions Kaalia's fall as the spine snaps and the skeleton falls, killing the bald man.
events.quote: Nira twisted her body so she cushioned Kaalia's fall.

events.summary: Nira tells Kaalia to flee, saying the rest of the Sunstrikers are lost.
events.quote: Now flee from here. The rest of us are lost.

events.summary: A blast splits the arena and the demon rises from the rift and slaughters the survivors.
events.quote: He arose from the rift that now cut across the floor.

events.summary: Kaalia awakes to devastation, learns the demon escaped, and vows revenge.

relations.note: Her pride is sworn to keep his lands safe.
relations.quote: Our pride is loyal to the great teacher, Ajani.

relations.note: She names and trains the girl as a warrior.
relations.quote: Among my people, a warrior receives a new name before her first battle,

relations.note: They have hunted him for a long time.
relations.quote: We've been hunting him for a long time.

relations.note: She swears to find a way to make him suffer.
